titulo: Your Christmas tree lights shouldn't stay on all night.
receta: regla con numero/lista corta + pregunta de si/no; pilar home safety, diciembre
destinatario: se lo manda alguien que ya puso el arbol a su familiar que lo deja prendido toda la noche
regla_guardable: Tree: water in the stand every day, lights off before you leave or go to bed.

interaccion.guardar: Christmas tree: check the water in the stand daily; lights off before leaving home or going to bed; lights with a testing-lab label.
interaccion.comentar: Does your tree stay lit all night? Yes or no?

fuentes: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology), Holiday Fire Safety (nist.gov/fire/holiday-fire-safety): 'Always turn off tree lights before leaving home or going to bed.' 'Always keep the tree well-watered. Make sure to check the water level in the stand daily.' 'Only use decorative lights that have the label of a recognized testing laboratory.' In NIST's test the dry tree caught fire and the watered tree did not ignite.

frases.texto: Your Christmas tree lights stay on all night.
frases.estilo: Dry and punchy, with a half smile.

frases.texto: The National Institute of Standards and Technology tested two trees. The dry one caught fire. The watered one didn't.
So check the water in the stand every day.
And always turn the tree lights off before you leave home or go to bed.
Heads up: only use lights with the label of a recognized testing lab.
Save this: water daily, and lights off when you leave or sleep.
Does your tree stay lit all night? Yes or no?
Send this to the friend who never turns the tree lights off.
